title: Chief Software Engineer

additionalInformation.label: RFIMS Operations, Maintenance and Sustainment follow-on contract

description: Led an eight-person software team delivering a radio-frequency analysis system that collected data on purpose-built embedded systems and classified it in AWS. Owned technical direction, execution planning, and security authorization needed to deploy the system to operational sites.
highlights: Directed architecture and implementation across embedded collection systems and the AWS GovCloud classification environment.
Managed the software budget, schedule, and execution plan for an eight-person team using EVMS and Agile Scrum.
Worked through NIST security controls and audit evidence to obtain Authorization to Operate for deployed systems.
Coordinated internal teams and customer stakeholders to deliver software capabilities to operational sites.
Resolved cross-team technical blockers while providing hands-on implementation support for high-priority work.
